summary_text: On 2026-04-24 (weekday), a single order was placed in the afternoon. The basket included seven items across six categories: Vegetables, Diaper, Curd Yogurt, Milk (two distinct products), Ice Creams, and Ready Meals. The combination of Milk and Vegetables is supported by historical co-order evidence (Support: 0.525, Confidence: 0.97, Lift: 1.038). The combination of Curd Yogurt and Vegetables is also supported (Support: 0.443, Confidence: 1.0, Lift: 1.07). The combination of Curd Yogurt and Milk is supported (Support: 0.344, Confidence: 0.778, Lift: 1.438). The presence of a Diaper suggests a household need for baby care, while Ready Meals and Ice Creams suggest convenience and indulgence. This is a single observation; no durable patterns can be established.
